answer: Agents verifying timber and willow provenance can resist Sybil attacks using zero-knowledge nullifier proofs. Each agent must anchor its public key in a SNARK proving a human sponsor holds a valid biometric credential while publishing a deterministic nullifier to block duplicate registrations privately. Attackers must secure the scarce resource of a distinct physical sponsor per fake identity. Still, coerced sponsors or compromised issuers can mint duplicate credentials.
